SELECT 
    bb.non_striker as player_id,
    COUNT(*) as times_non_striker_with_runs,
    SUM(bs.runs_scored) as total_runs
FROM batsman_scored bs
JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON bs.match_id = bb.match_id AND bs.over_id = bb.over_id AND bs.ball_id = bb.ball_id
JOIN match m ON bs.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE m.season_id = 5
GROUP BY bb.non_striker
HAVING SUM(bs.runs_scored) > 0
ORDER BY SUM(bs.runs_scored) DESC
LIMIT 5

    SELECT bb.striker as player_id, 
           bb.match_id, 
           SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0)) as runs
    FROM ball_by_ball bb 
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    WHERE bb.striker IS NOT NULL 
      AND bb.match_id IN (SELECT match_id FROM match WHERE season_id = 5)
    GROUP BY bb.striker, bb.match_id
),
player_matches AS (
    SELECT player_id, COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) as matches_played
    FROM player_runs
    GROUP BY player_id
),
player_balls AS (
    SELECT bb.striker as player_id, COUNT(*) as balls_faced
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    WHERE bb.striker IS NOT NULL 
      AND bb.match_id IN (SELECT match_id FROM match WHERE season_id = 5)
    GROUP BY bb.striker
),
player_totals AS (
    SELECT pr.player_id, 
           SUM(pr.runs) as total_runs,
           pm.matches_played,
           pb.balls_faced
    FROM player_runs pr
    JOIN player_matches pm ON pr.player_id = pm.player_id
    JOIN player_balls pb ON pr.player_id = pb.player_id

)

FROM player_totals pt
JOIN player p ON pt.player_id = p.player_id

SQL:
WITH player_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        pm.player_id,
        p.player_name,
        COUNT(DISTINCT m.match_id) as matches_played,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) as total_runs
    FROM player_match pm
    JOIN match m ON pm.match_id = m.match_id
    JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON pm.match_id = bb.match_id
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    JOIN player p ON pm.player_id = p.player_id
    WHERE m.season_id = 5
    AND bb.striker = pm.player_id
    AND bs.runs_scored IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY pm.player_id, p.player_name
),
wicket_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        pm.player_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT wt.match_id) as wickets_lost
    FROM player_match pm
    JOIN match m ON pm.match_id = m.match_id
    JOIN wicket_taken wt ON pm.match_id = wt.match_id AND wt.player_out = pm.player_id
    WHERE m.season_id = 5
    GROUP BY pm.player_id
)
SELECT 
    ps.player_name,
    ROUND(CAST(ps.total_runs AS DOUBLE) / ps.matches_played, 2) as avg_runs_per_match,
    ROUND(CAST(ps.total_runs AS DOUBLE) / COALESCE(ws.wickets_lost, 1), 2) as batting_average
FROM player_stats ps
LEFT JOIN wicket_stats ws ON ps.player_id = ws.player_id
ORDER BY avg_runs_per_match DESC
LIMIT 5
